newsitem.title: ESTONIA: UHIS TO LAUNCH LEASING IN RUSSIA.
newsitem.headline: UHIS TO LAUNCH LEASING IN RUSSIA.

text.p: Uhispank will next week sign an agreement with a Russian company to launch a leasing firm in St Petersburg, the bank said on Thursday.
Uhispank will have 75 percent of the new company and the Russian partner 25 percent of the share capital of one billion roubles, Uhispank vice-president Janek Maggi told Reuters.
Uhispank will announce the partner next week, Maggi said.
"It is not a giant," he added, saying the bank would broaden its leasing business into other countries.
"At the end of this year we want to be present in Latvia and Lithuania," he added.
Uhispank's leasing subsidiary, Uhisliising, had a market share of 12.8 percent in Estonia's leasing market and its assets were at 300 million kroons in 1996.
